title: I asked AI to get a farmer across a river 🐔

beats.big:
A farmer.
Two chickens.
One boat.
beats.say: A farmer, two chickens, and one boat.
The boat fits one person and two animals. How many crossings does he need?
AI: Step one. Take the first chicken across. Step two. Return alone.
In one test, an AI needed five crossings.
Someone even told GPT-4o the farmer doesn't need to cross at all.

beats.sub: one theory: it recites the famous wolf, goat and cabbage answer
beats.say: One theory: it spots the famous wolf, goat and cabbage puzzle, and recites that answer instead of reading yours.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
